avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin B12 supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Emtricitabine may impair B12 absorption; excessive supplementation could mask deficiency or cause imbalance
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor B12 levels regularly; use standard doses only if supplementation is necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Nephrotoxic herbal supplements (e.g., aristolochic acid-containing herbs)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Emtricitabine is renally eliminated; nephrotoxic agents increase risk of renal impairment and drug accumulation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; consult pharmacist before using any herbal kidney support products

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May theoretically affect gastrointestinal absorption, though clinical significance is minimal for emtricitabine
caution_supplements.action: Use standard probiotic formulations; maintain consistent timing separate from dosing

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have immune-modulating effects that could theoretically interact with antiretroviral therapy mechanisms
caution_supplements.action: Use in moderation; inform healthcare provider of concurrent use

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay absorption of emtricitabine; clinical significance is minimal as food effect is not substantial
caution_foods.action: May take with or without food; consistency in timing is more important than fasting

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive alcohol may impair adherence and liver function; emtricitabine has minimal hepatic metabolism but overall antiretroviral regimen may include hepatically-metabolized agents
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption; maintain liver health monitoring

monitoring_notes: Emtricitabine has minimal drug interactions due to limited hepatic metabolism and primarily renal elimination. Monitor renal function regularly, as nephrotoxic substances may impair clearance and increase toxicity risk. Ensure consistent adherence and assess for lactic acidosis symptoms with concurrent medications.
